title: mri_gtmpvc
description: mri_gtmpvc performs partial volume correction on PET data using anatomical segmentation.

input_volume.description: Input volume: source data to PVC
input_volume.title: Input volume

frame.description: Only process 0-based frame F from input volume
frame.title: Frame

segmentation.description: Anatomical segmentation to define regions for GTM
segmentation.title: Segmentation file

registration.description: LTA registration file that maps PET to anatomical
registration.title: Registration file

regheader.description: Assume input and seg share scanner space
regheader.title: Regheader flag

reg_identity.description: Assume that input is in anatomical space
reg_identity.title: Reg Identity flag

mask.description: Ignore areas outside of the mask (in input vol space)
mask.title: Mask volume

auto_mask.description: Automatically compute mask with FWHM and threshold
auto_mask.title: Auto mask

no_reduce_fov.description: Do not reduce FoV to encompass mask
no_reduce_fov.title: No reduce field of view

reduce_fov_eqodd.description: Reduce FoV to encompass mask but force nc=nr and ns to be odd
reduce_fov_eqodd.title: Reduce FoV to odd dimensions

merge_hypos.description: Merge left and right hypointensites into ROI
merge_hypos.title: Merge hypointensites

merge_cblum_wm_gyri.description: Cerebellum WM gyri back into cerebellum WM
merge_cblum_wm_gyri.title: Merge cerebellum WM gyri

tt_reduce.description: Reduce segmentation to that of a tissue type
tt_reduce.title: Tissue-type reduce

replace_seg.description: Replace seg Id1 with seg Id2
replace_seg.title: Replace segmentation IDs

replace_file.description: File with a list of Ids to replace
replace_file.title: Replace file

rescale.description: Specify reference region(s) used to rescale (default is pons)
rescale.title: Rescale

no_rescale.description: Do not global rescale such that mean of reference region is scaleref
no_rescale.title: No rescale

scale_refval.description: Scale such that mean in reference region is refval
scale_refval.title: Scale reference value

tt_update.description: Changes tissue type of VentralDC, BrainStem, and Pons to be SubcortGM
tt_update.title: Tissue type update

no_tfe.description: Do not correct for tissue fraction effect
no_tfe.title: No TFE correction

segpvfres.description: Set the tissue fraction resolution parameter (default is 0.5)
segpvfres.title: Tissue fraction resolution

mg_ref_lobes_wm.description: Set MG RefIds to those for lobes when using wm subseg
mg_ref_lobes_wm.title: MG Reference Lobes WM

km_ref.description: Compute reference TAC for KM as mean of given RefIds
km_ref.title: KM Reference TAC

km_hb.description: Compute HiBinding TAC for KM as mean of given RefIds
km_hb.title: KM HiBinding TAC

steady_state.description: Steady-state analysis spec blood plasma concentration, unit scale, and decay correction factor.
steady_state.title: Steady-state analysis

save_x.description: Save X matrix in matlab4 format as X.mat
save_x.title: Save X matrix

save_y.description: Save y matrix in matlab4 format as y.mat
save_y.title: Save y matrix

save_beta.description: Save beta matrix in matlab4 format as beta.mat
save_beta.title: Save beta matrix

save_x0.description: Save X0 matrix in matlab4 format as X0.mat
save_x0.title: Save X0 matrix

save_yhat_noise.description: Saves yhat with noise, seed < 0 for TOD
save_yhat_noise.title: Save yhat with noise

save_yhat_full_fov.description: Saves yhat in full FoV (if FoV was reduced)
save_yhat_full_fov.title: Save yhat full FoV

synth.description: Synthesize volume with gtmbeta as input
synth.title: Synthesize volume

synth_save.description: With --synth saves synthesized volume to outdir/synth.nii.gz
synth_save.title: Synthesize save

save_text.description: Save demeaned GTM values out to text files named after the seg
save_text.title: Save text

max_threads.description: Use the maximum allowable number of threads for this computer
max_threads.title: Max threads

max_threads_minus_one.description: Use one less than the maximum allowable number of threads for this computer
max_threads_minus_one.title: Max threads minus one

checkopts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit
checkopts.title: Check options

help.description: Print out information on how to use this program
help.title: Help
